ev.q: 71 Ebola cases among the population of approximately 80,000 Liberians
39 of those cases were fatal (mortality rate = 68%)
Twenty-one (28%) quarantined contacts from high-risk exposures developed Ebola.
Fifty-three Ebola cases were fatal, of which 39 were confirmed cases (mortality rate among confirmed cases = 68%).
During the same period, there were 536 Ebola cases in Margibi County (cumulative incidence = 0.23%).
Among those were 27 with confirmed Ebola (ETU mortality rate = 60%)
